snapshot_note: Reviewed local runtime snapshot for current-protocol OT-2 and Flex previews; refresh with scripts/sync-renderer.mjs after source changes.

analysis_entrypoints.ot2_python: sim/play_ot2_protocol.py -> public opentrons.cli analyze --check (OT-2 .py input only)
analysis_entrypoints.analysis_json: sim/web_player.py accepts an existing analysis JSON directly for OT-2 and Flex
analysis_entrypoints.flex_analysis_json: sim/flex3d_runtime/flex_protocol.py loader; loader errors reject invalid input; this path is not an analyze --check CLI

python_dependencies.launcher: LABSCRIPTAI_PYTHON is shared with the code service

replay_behavior.unknown_actions: Unknown actions, unsupported module commands, addressable areas, robot/model mismatches, and unsupported home axes are rejected with ProtocolError; there is no silent fallback.
replay_behavior.air_segments: airGap/airGapInPlace and aspirates above a well opening remain explicit air segments with separate tip-air state; analysis coordinates remain the source of motion positions.
replay_behavior.home: Full home and x/y, leftZ/rightZ, leftPlunger/rightPlunger axis-home commands are replayed; unknown axes are rejected.

supported_scope.static_layout_overlap: Static definition-envelope overlap is surfaced as a partial warning. It is not precise continuous collision certification or physical hardware acceptance.

assets.excluded: Reference images, manuals, STEP/DXF files, Blender/GLB duplicates, STL module duplicates, generated exports and caches are not runtime inputs.

generated_output.override: LABSCRIPTAI_RENDERER_EXPORT (plus FLEX3D_EXPORT for isolated Flex output)

validation_scope.supported_range: OT-2 replay covers 12 pipette models and 5 module definitions listed in supported_scope; unsupported actions and model names are rejected.
validation_scope.warnings: Plan warnings are returned in info and make digital validation partial.
validation_scope.static_overlap: Definition-envelope overlap is reported as a partial warning, not a precise continuous collision check or clearance certificate.
validation_scope.limitation: Validation is a digital model replay, not physical robot acceptance or a continuous hardware clearance certificate.
validation_scope.timing: Motion and thermal ramp durations are illustrative; explicit waits and thermal holds are preserved.
validation_scope.flex_touch_tip: Known text-only action with an explicit warning; contact waypoints are not modeled.
validation_scope.partial_nozzle_layout: Flex ALL layouts supported; partial layouts explicitly rejected before playback.

historical_evidence.note: These records document the earlier external-renderer workflow and are retained for review provenance; they are not applied by the bundled launcher.

provenance.citation: Gao, Yuan et al. Autonomous Liquid-handling Robotics Scripting for Accessible and Responsible Protein Engineering. bioRxiv (2025). DOI 10.1101/2025.09.30.679666.
provenance.upstream_asset_metadata: The copied Flex manifest retains its Opentrons source-definition fields.
